summary: The diff implements most of the required features: migration.mo is added with enteredBy migration for all record types, backend/main.mo includes listPendingUsers, approve/reject via setApproval, and migration logic, frontend tabs (Income, Expense, Inventory, Sales, Attendance, Customers) now include 'Entered By' columns, and VerificationTab is updated with approve/reject functionality. However, some acceptance criteria cannot be fully verified due to truncation, and there are a few concerns noted below.

missing_requirements.requirement: Existing users without an approval status are migrated to an appropriate default status on upgrade; Migration logic is placed in migration.mo
missing_requirements.reason: The migration.mo file handles enteredBy field migration for records but does not appear to contain user approval status migration logic. The file only defines OldActor types for inventory/customers/income/expenses/sales/workers and migrates enteredBy fields, with no user approval state migration for existing users without a verified status.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each row shows the user's name, identifier, and status
missing_requirements.reason: The VerificationTab table headers shown in the diff only include 'Principal', 'Status', and 'Actions' columns. There is no 'Name' column visible in the table headers, so the user's name may not be displayed per the AC requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: listPendingUsers query returning UserProfile objects as a separate endpoint
hallucinated_features.reason: The backend exposes a listPendingUsers function returning [UserProfile], but this was not explicitly requested. The requested function was to list pending approvals (returning approval info with principal/status), which appears to already be covered by the existing listApprovals endpoint. Adding a separate listPendingUsers returning UserProfile objects was not specified in the build request.
